stock and warrants were issued. The value of the conversion feature and warrants recorded to equity during the years ended December 31,

for warrants issued and netted against the transaction recorded to equity.</i></span></td>
</tr></table>
<p id="xdx_8A3_zRYSKj8W5Dc7" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b>Senior Debentures</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On June 6, 2019, the Company entered into a convertible
senior secured debenture (the &#8220;Senior Debentures&#8221;) in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed $<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentFaceAmount_iI_c20190606__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeniorDebenturesMember__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__us-gaap--InvestorMember_zCE9i96Au3E4">35,000,000</span> with accredited
investors and qualified institutional buyers wherein the Senior Debentures shall mature on June 6, 2022 and bear interest at a rate of
<span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateDuringPeriod_pid_dp_c20190606__20190606__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeniorDebenturesMember__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__us-gaap--InvestorMember_z1xe7qZiPlQh">9.0</span>%. The Senior Debentures are to be issued from time to time at the election of the Company pursuant to one or more subscription agreements.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Senior Debentures contain two conversion
features wherein <span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--DebtConversionDescription_c20190606__20190606__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeniorDebenturesMember__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__us-gaap--InvestorMember_z8iwZZ1sovZc">the conversion rate is equal to $1,000 principal amount of debentures divided by the conversion price, which is the
lesser of (i) the price that is a 25% discount to the liquidity event price and (ii) the price determined based on a pre-money enterprise
value of the Company of $150,000,000. The initial conversion rate shall be determined immediately upon the consummation of a liquidity
event and shall be subject to adjustment.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>



<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In the event that a liquidity event, as defined
in the Senior Debentures agreement, is consummated, holders have the right, at the holder&#8217;s option, to convert all or any portion
of their Senior Debentures into the Company&#8217;s common shares (the &#8220;Optional Conversion&#8221;). Additionally, at the Company&#8217;s
election, the Company has the right to convert all outstanding debentures into common shares if all of the following conditions are satisfied,
with no further action by the holders (the &#8220;Mandatory Conversion&#8221;):</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; font-size: 10pt">
  <tr style="vertical-align: top">
    <td style="width: 48px">&#160;</td>
    <td style="width: 24px"><span style="font-size: 10pt">(i)</span></td>
    <td style="text-align: justify"><span style="font-size: 10pt">A liquidity event has been consummated;</span></td></tr>
  <tr style="vertical-align: top">
    <td>&#160;</td>
    <td><span style="font-size: 10pt">(ii)</span></td>
    <td style="text-align: justify"><span style="font-size: 10pt">The liquidity event price is at least 100% greater than the conversion
    price;</span></td></tr>
  <tr style="vertical-align: top">
    <td>&#160;</td>
    <td><span style="font-size: 10pt">(iii)</span></td>
    <td style="text-align: justify"><span style="font-size: 10pt">The common shares are listed on a recognized Canadian stock exchange
    or a national U.S. stock exchange; and</span></td></tr>
  <tr style="vertical-align: top">
    <td>&#160;</td>
    <td><span style="font-size: 10pt">(iv)</span></td>
    <td style="text-align: justify"><span style="font-size: 10pt">The daily VWAP of the common share is 20% greater than the liquidity
    event price for at least 10 consecutive trading days immediately prior to the date of the Company&#8217;s conversion notice.</span></td></tr>
  </table>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company may issue up to $<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentFaceAmount_iI_c20190606__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeniorDebenturesMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zRTuEBbLydk9">3,500,000</span> aggregate
principal amount of debentures without the consent of or notice to the holders in the event a Liquidity Event is not consummated on or
prior to June 6, 2020. Pursuant to the Agency Agreement, in the event a liquidity event has not occurred by June 6, 2020, the Company
will issue additional Debenture Units in an aggregate principal amount equal to <span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePercentage_iI_dp_c20190606__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeniorDebenturesMember_zpXtUq7Ae3f9">10</span>% of the aggregate number of Debenture Units initially
issued to the purchaser as a penalty. In June 2020, the Company issued additional Senior Debentures totaling $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentIssuedPrincipal_c20200601__20200630__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeniorDebenturesMember_zKtsAfSoFnjb">1,467,000</span> as a result of
this provision. In connection with the additional debentures issued, the Company recognized a derivative liability of $<span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--DerivativeLiabilities_iI_c20200630__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeniorDebenturesMember_zVVAofhIGEEj">427,246</span> and also
recorded an offsetting debt discount.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Effective September 9, 2022, the Company amended
its Senior Debentures as part of a restructuring support agreement with Icanic Brands (the &#8220;Modification&#8221;). The Modification
provides for <span id="xdx_90F_ecustom--DebtInstrumentInterestOutstandingPrincipalRate_iI_dp_c20220909__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeniorDebenturesMember_zIcrRn3mzS8g" title="Debt instrument interest outstanding principal rate">25</span>% of the outstanding principal and accrued unpaid interest to be settled in cash with the remaining <span id="xdx_90D_ecustom--OutstandingConvertibleDebenturesSettlementPercentage_iI_dp_c20220909__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeniorDebenturesMember_zzKcELvDYMz8" title="Outstanding convertible debentures settlement percentage">75</span>% settled in new
convertible debentures which bear interest at <span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePercentage_iI_dp_c20220909__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeniorDebenturesMember_zvGioa5GnDKf">11</span>% and convert into units at Canadian dollars (&#8220;C$&#8221;) $<span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1_iI_uCADPShares_c20220909__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeniorDebenturesMember_zuOEX41eeN">0.10</span> with each unit
comprised of an Icanic Brands common share and share purchase warrant exercisable into Icanic Brands common share at a price of C$<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1_iI_uCADPShares_c20220909__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeniorDebenturesMember_zSenWGGCXK1c">0.15</span>
per share for a period of 24 months from the date of conversion (&#8220;Conversion Option&#8221;). The Conversion Option was determined
to be a derivative under ASC 825<i>, Financial Instruments</i>, as the Conversion Option is denominated in a currency other than the
Company&#8217;s functional currency. See &#8220;<i>Note 11 &#8211; Derivative Liabilities</i>&#8221; for further details.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On September 8, 2022, the Company closed a non-brokered
private placement of new secured debentures in the aggregate principal amount of C$<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentFaceAmount_iI_uCAD_c20220908__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--AdditionalSecuredDebenturesMember_zd0lWCLyTrrj">1,300,000</span> (the &#8220;Additional Secured Debentures&#8221;).
The Additional Secured Debentures have been issued pursuant to a debenture indenture entered into as of September 8, 2022 (the &#8220;Indenture&#8221;).
Pursuant to the Indenture, the Company can issue up to an aggregate of CAD$<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentFaceAmount_iI_uCAD_c20220908__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--AdditionalSecuredDebenturesMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_z4AQSSg4ztC4">4,000,000</span> in connection with the offering. The Additional
Secured Debentures bear interest at a rate of <span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePercentage_iI_dp_c20220908__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--AdditionalSecuredDebenturesMember_zeOiQi93mRoi">11.0</span>% per annum and mature <span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentTerm_dtM_c20220908__20220908__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--AdditionalSecuredDebenturesMember_zzzLm7eCXHZ4">24</span>-months from the date of issue (<span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentIssuanceDate1_dd_c20220908__20220908__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--AdditionalSecuredDebenturesMember_zdEgFiW9gqOk">September 8, 2024</span>). The interest
accrued under the Additional Secured Debentures is payable in cash upon maturity. Additional Secured Debentures have the same conversion
option as Senior Debentures after the Modification. The conversion option is denominated in a functional currency (CAD) that is different
as the issuer (USD) and as such needs to be assessed for derivative treatment. Upon further analysis, it was deemed the instrument had
an embedded derivative and as such has been recorded as a component of debt.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In connection with the initial issuance of the
Senior Debentures, share purchase warrants (&#8220;Senior Warrants&#8221;) exercisable into common shares based on its issue price divided
by its conversion price were also issued. The conversion price is equal to the lesser of: (A) the price that is a <span id="xdx_904_ecustom--PercentageOfDiscountToLiquidityEventPrice_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20220908__us-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightAxis__custom--SeniorWarrantsMember_znnrCtgTQ4N2" title="Percentage of discount to liquidity event price">25</span>% discount to the
liquidity event price and (B) the price determined based on a certain value. The exercise price is a price per common share which is
50% greater than the conversion price. The exercise price is subject to adjustment in the event of a common share reorganization, rights
offering, special distribution, or capital reorganization. The warrants are exercisable upon the occurrence of a liquidity event, as
defined in the Senior Warrant agreement, and the exercise period is the 24 months following the liquidity event date, provided that if
a liquidity event has not occurred within five (<span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--WarrantsAndRightsOutstandingTerm_iI_dtY_c20220908__us-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightAxis__custom--SeniorWarrantsMember_z7SckBYAljD1">5</span>) years from the initial closing date of this offering, the warrants shall expire. Initially
the aggregate value of these warrants included a potentially embedded feature to be treated as a derivative but was determined to be
de minimis. The embedded conversion feature of the Senior Debentures has been deemed to be a derivative. See &#8220;<i>Note 11 &#8211;
Derivative Liabilities</i>&#8221; for further details. Subsequent to the merger with LEEF, the Senior Warrants were effectively issued
as part of the share exchange terms noted in the Merger Agreement between LEEF and Icanic. As such, there were <span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights_iI_pid_c20220908__us-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightAxis__custom--SeniorWarrantsMember_zf3Ognb0Jeoc">6,616,800</span> warrants issued
from the original <span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights_iI_pid_c20220908__us-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightAxis__custom--SeniorWarrantsMember__srt--ConsolidatedEntitiesAxis__srt--ParentCompanyMember_zSDSoCodg37b">527,338</span> warrants of LEEF due to the agreed upon <span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1_iI_pid_c20220908__us-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightAxis__custom--SeniorWarrantsMember_z0wZbngzLOM">12.55</span> conversion ratio. See &#8220;<i>Note 18 &#8211; Share Capital</i>&#8221;
for further details on warrant activity for the year ended December 31, 2024. As a result of the non-fixed number of shares the Additional
Senior Debentures can be converted or exercised into, these features were recognized as a derivative liability (see &#8220;<i>Note 11
&#8211; Derivative Liabilities</i>&#8221;).</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>



<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On April 19, 2024, the Company amended its Indenture
Agreement by restructuring its debentures through a conversion of the balance due to certain debenture holders and extinguishment debt.
Per the amendments, the remaining balance due under the updated agreement is due September 9, 2027. The Company converted debenture balances
totaling approximately $<span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentAmount1_pn5n6_c20240419__20240419_zTi3WYwFzlc6" title="Converted amount">4.9</span> million into <span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentSharesIssued1_c20240419__20240419__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__us-gaap--CommonStockMember_zbzcm1N0Q7mk" title="Converted amount, shares">22,395,948</span> common shares at a conversion price of approximately $<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1_iI_c20240419__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__us-gaap--CommonStockMember_zBjg8CsJmb35" title="Converted amount, per shares">0.02</span> per share, which also
triggered the issuance of <span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByEachWarrantOrRight_iI_c20240419__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__us-gaap--CommonStockMember_z2Yb5EVNangi" title="Purchase of warrants">22,395,950</span> warrants to purchase the Company&#8217;s common stock, together valued at $<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--FairValueAdjustmentOfWarrants_pn5n6_c20240419__20240419__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__us-gaap--CommonStockMember_zSAacM9Z5Cdb" title="Purchase of warrants, value">7.9</span> million. The Company
has recorded a loss on extinguishment of debt as part of this transaction.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In December 2025, the Company converted the outstanding
convertible debentures and accrued interest totaling approximately $<span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentAmount1_pn5n6_c20251231__20251231_zJBU63tXTuk8" title="Converted amount">10.7</span> million into <span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentSharesIssued1_c20251231__20251231__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__us-gaap--CommonStockMember_z7u6SeQXlq3g" title="Converted amount, shares">60,155,339</span> common shares at a conversion price
of approximately CAD$<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1_iI_uCADPShares_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__us-gaap--CommonStockMember_zIzfJ1mZxBJd" title="Converted amount, per shares">0.25</span> per share, a change from the stated conversion terms, which also triggered the issuance of <span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByEachWarrantOrRight_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__us-gaap--CommonStockMember_zwkE4rPFVYO8" title="Purchase of warrants">60,155,339</span> warrants to purchase the Company&#8217;s common stock,
together valued at $<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--FairValueAdjustmentOfWarrants_pn5n6_c20251231__20251231__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__us-gaap--CommonStockMember_zmXspjeTMXmb" title="Purchase of warrants, value">16.9</span> million. The Company has recorded a loss on extinguishment of debt as part of this transaction.</p>
